description: single storey side extension that projects to the rear of the property
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: CA-R00-PR-101; CA-R00-PR-102; CA-R00-PR-103; CA-R00-PR-104; CA-R00-EX-101; CA-R00-EX-102; CA-R00-EX-103; Flood Risk Assessment; Fire Statement
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal">The
development should not be commenced until a satisfactory Flood Risk Assessment<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(FRA)
with flood data and flood mitigation measures are submitted to and approved by
the Harrow Infrastructure Team.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">The
applicant should ensure that the structure is designed to mitigate the effects
of any<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">possible
flooding on site or elsewhere and include resistance and resilience to
flooding.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">The
applicant’s attention should be drawn to the National Planning Policy
Framework, as a reference for flood risk development.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">The
applicant can contact the Harrow Infrastructure Team for further information regarding
this matter.</p><p class="MsoNormal"><br></p><p class="MsoNormal"><br></p>
